Alex.day_scenario: Alex rises at 6:30 AM to join a video conference from the home office, then heads out to traffic while an audiobook narrates a historical biography. After wrapping up project deliverables over a quick desk lunch, Alex finally clocks off and unwinds with a cup of tea before settling into bed at 23:00.

Leo.day_scenario: Leo wakes at 7:00 AM to stack wooden blocks in the living room before his caregiver takes him to part-time preschool for morning stories and snacks. He returns home to finish constructing a tall red tower in the hallway, leaving it standing right in the middle of the floor until his evening bath and bedtime at 20:00.

Mia.day_scenario: Mia wakes at 7:00 AM and spreads her drawing paper across the kitchen counter, carefully coloring pictures of flowers and butterflies with her favorite wax crayons. She leaves her art supplies scattered on the dining table after finishing her morning session, then spends the afternoon playing quietly before her routine bedtime at 20:30.
